visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Real headings instead of bold paragraphs
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This page fakes headings with bold paragraphs. Replace them with h1 and h2 so the outline is real. The visible text must not change.

solution.explanation: A bold paragraph looks like a heading but has no meaning, so a screen reader cannot jump between sections. h1 and h2 give the same words a structure, and CSS can still style them.
